shared_or_similar_visual_information: Short transverse tick strokes repeated across line segments.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It marks BT and TE as equal-length pieces of the segment BE. Right image: It marks the two bottom-edge portions as equal in length.
Rationales: On both sides matching transverse ticks group segments that have equal lengths within that diagram. A single-tick group and a double-tick group use the same equality convention; this does not assert equal numerical lengths between the two separate problems.
